page.content:
Specialty movement that treats origin, roast, and brew as craft.

How Third wave coffee connects

  • Topic: Coffee terroir — Third wave talks about coffee as terroir, like wine.
  • Item: Pour-over — Pour-over is a ritual brew method of the third wave.
  • Topic: Specialty coffee — Specialty grading is the trade language of the third wave.
  • Faction: Starbucks — Third wave defined itself after and against Starbucks-scale second-wave espresso.

What is Third wave coffee?

Third wave names the post-Starbucks specialty scene: lighter roasts, single origins, pour-over bars, and the barista as taster rather than just operator.

Key threads lead to Coffee terroir, Pour-over, Specialty coffee and Starbucks.
